title: ISO 16889:2022 — Hydraulic fluid power — Filters — Multi-pass method for evaluating filtration performance of a filter element
locator: Abstract: multi-pass filtration test with continuous contaminant injection for hydraulic fluid power filter elements; determines contaminant capacity, particulate removal and differential pressure characteristics.
notes: The published scope specifies application conditions for the filter element test, including a defined filtration ratio/particle size and reservoir gravimetric level. It is not a test method for machine-tool coolant filters or proof of total-system cleanliness. Use the exact standard text and agreed test conditions for contract work.
